milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the carved pumpkin (placed on top of the oak hut at spawn-relative [4, 4, 6]) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. max_distance=16 allows spotting from ground level near the hut, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the pumpkin rather than facing away.
